findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - several closes or land children encounter a rate limit while GitHub's quota endpoint is slow.
The new endpoints are times when the fake quota request runs, not when the wait starts or check polling resumes. Before a quota request, `_quota` acquires a shared lock; rate-limit retries force fresh requests that can each take 60 seconds (src/forge/github.py:19, 26, 173–175). A waiter queued behind several slow requests can therefore remain silent for minutes before its first recorded read, while this single-close test still passes. A delay after the last read and before polling resumes is also outside the measured interval. Capture the wait trigger and the first resumed action to bound both gaps.
